reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and the named lab report for the batch plus the empty-box guarantee make one box at $24.99 an easy low-risk try. I'd buy one box, not two, until I see if it sits well.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put 8 forms in one capsule? Bisglycinate is fine, but I'm not sure one form is enough.
